result.title: How to Set Up Finances in ChatGPT
result.description:
Finances in ChatGPT can help you get a clearer picture of your spending and find ways to make progress toward your financial goals.

result.title: Experiment with SVG & 3D Design with the Codex Plugin
result.description:
Craig Dennis had never drawn an SVG by hand or used Blender. With the SVG & 3D Design plugin for Codex, he shows how to turn a reference image into an editable graphic or 3D model, then ask for changes in plain language.

See how a small change in SVG code can make a character’s eyes follow your cursor, and how Codex uses Blender to check a model from another angle. Enable SVG & 3D Design in Codex and tell us what you build!

Learn more:
SVG & 3D Design Plugin: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/Plugin_13c5903473e081919917a1070fad1dd1?open_in_app
Guide - From concept art to editable SVGs and 3D scenes:  https://learn.chatgpt.com/guides/svg-3d-design

result.title: How to Search for Exoplanets
result.description:
Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd, independently found signals that could point to planets around distant stars. They knew you didn't need your own telescope for this kind of hunt. 

Kevin used Codex and Ethan used Astra to search public telescope data for tiny, recurring dips in starlight that an orbiting planet can cause. Both found signals worth a second look. https://openai.com/index/searching-for-distant-planets-with-astra/
